Name: (CP) Mid Autumn Festival Mooncakes
Author: joegosama
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#dbb0a7]模组介绍：[/color][color=#ffff00]Introducing in English below.[/color][/b][/size]
这个mod新增了9种月饼，详细信息见图片
莲蓉蛋黄月饼
广式五仁月饼
芝麻豆沙月饼
冰皮椰蓉月饼
抹茶水果月饼
金钩海味月饼
流心奶黄月饼
流心可可月饼
玫瑰鲜花月饼

新增了中秋月饼礼盒，可以在铁匠铺打开获得月饼

新增了怪物掉落规则，杀死怪物会有10%几率掉落“中秋月饼礼盒”

为皮埃尔的商店新增了“中秋月饼礼盒”商品，价格300金，无限购买

可以配置中秋月饼礼盒是否可获取

与“[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27440]不要饿死在星露谷Don't Starve in Stardew Valley[/url]”联动 ←点击进入该模组界面
安装该模组后，将体验到此模组的全部内容，并且新增了3种饥荒专属月饼[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]（因此你无需再安装本mod）[/size][/color][/b]
冰皮榴莲月饼（饥荒mod特有）
酥皮云腿月饼（饥荒mod特有）
酥皮怪物月饼（饥荒mod特有）

[color=#dbb0a7]ModIntroduction:[/color]
This mod adds 9 new types of mooncakes. See images for details.
Lotus Seed Egg Yolk Mooncake
Cantonese Five Kernel Mooncake
Sesame Bean Paste Mooncake
Snowy Coconut Mooncake
Matcha Fruit Mooncake
Shrimp Seafood Mooncake
Custard Mooncake
Flowing Chocolate Mooncake
Rose Flower Mooncake

[/size]Added Mid-Autumn Mooncake Gift Box.You can open it in the blacksmith shopAdded a new monster drop rule. There is a 10% chance to drop "Mid-Autumn Mooncake Gift Box" when killing monstersPierre's shop will sell "Mid-Autumn Mooncake Gift Box" for 300 gold with unlimited stock
Can configure whether the Mid-Autumn Mooncake Gift Box is obtainable
Linkage with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27440]Don't Starve in Stardew Valley[/url]" ← click to enter the mod interface
Once you install the mod, you will experience what this mod is all about. And 3 new Don't Starve exclusive mooncakes have been added [b][color=#ff0000][size=4](so you don't need to install this mod again)[/size][/color][/b]
Snowy Durian Mooncake (Exclusive to Don't Starve in Stardew Valley﻿ mod)
Puff Pastry Yunnan Ham Mooncake (Exclusive to Don't Starve in Stardew Valley﻿ mod)
Puff Pastry Monster Mooncake (Exclusive to Don't Starve in Stardew Valley﻿ mod)
